title: Footer Fine Tuning
request: Oct 19 2026 16:10 ICT: Max asked 'prepare fresh new decks on the same topics i swiped on. they don't have to be as long. i like 10 at a time.'
example_data: Laptop browser mockups (1366 wide) of the board in its decided state with a CLOSE-UP panel for the asked element; TEST / SAMPLE data, Tech Dash 1-3, Van 1-3, members by first name or ID only. No share button; Built by Machan centred opens the Machan story page.
no_cap: Max asked for 10 at a time (Oct 19 2026)

pairs.ask: UpKeep Board Footer: Credit with mark, with Built by Machan centred and no share, should the UP mark sit beside the words or the words stand alone?

optionA.label: Mark Beside Words
optionA.desc: Small UP mark, then Built by Machan.
